reviews.name: Sophie b
reviews.text:
Wowwww! Just recieved our order, we wanted a nibble so got Salt n pepper chips, sweet n sour sauce to dip, crispy duck 1/2 and salt and pepper ribs.
The ribs are the absolute BEST ribs I've ever had. Food portions are amazing, the rest is also fantastic by the way but I'm so fussy with ribs that's why I emphasised.
Highly recommend. Thus is our second time ordering from here, our first was a late night one and they didn't disappoint then either.
Fresh, decent delivery time, really good portion sizes, and outstanding food.
Thank-you. Definitely our go to Chinese now. Thank-you to all staff!

We had already starting tucking in before I took the photos FYI 😅
reviews.textTranslated:
Wowww! Baru saja menerima pesanan kami, kami ingin sedikit camilan jadi kami memesan keripik kentang garam dan merica, saus asam manis untuk dicelupkan, setengah bebek crispy, dan iga garam dan merica.
Iganya adalah iga TERBAIK yang pernah saya makan. Porsi makanannya luar biasa, sisanya juga fantastis, tapi saya sangat pilih-pilih soal iga, makanya saya menekankannya.
Sangat direkomendasikan. Ini adalah kali kedua kami memesan dari sini, yang pertama adalah larut malam dan mereka juga tidak mengecewakan.
Segar, waktu pengiriman cukup baik, ukuran porsi sangat bagus, dan makanan luar biasa.
Terima kasih. Pasti akan menjadi restoran Cina favorit kami sekarang. Terima kasih kepada semua staf!

Kami sudah mulai makan sebelum saya mengambil foto, FYI 😅

reviews.text: Excellent .love the noodle box
reviews.textTranslated: Luar biasa. Saya suka kotak mienya.

reviews.text: The Noobles Combo Box has massive portions, loads of meat and noodles amazing !
reviews.textTranslated: Noobles Combo Box memiliki porsi yang besar, banyak daging dan mie yang luar biasa!

reviews.name: Ron Weasley
reviews.text: This restaurant is very clean and tidy. They have an open kitchen, so you can see the food being prepared. The staff are friendly, and the food is delicious. Recommended.
reviews.textTranslated: Restoran ini sangat bersih dan rapi. Mereka memiliki dapur terbuka, sehingga Anda dapat melihat makanan disiapkan. Stafnya ramah, dan makanannya lezat. Direkomendasikan.

reviews.name: food newhongkong
reviews.text: excellent as always. delivered well within expected delivery time. never disappointed.
reviews.textTranslated: Luar biasa seperti biasanya. Dikirim tepat waktu sesuai perkiraan. Tidak pernah mengecewakan.

reviews.name: O A F C
reviews.text: Got food poisoning
reviews.textTranslated: Keracunan makanan
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: This joke isn't funny. Bring your receipt to the store, and we'll investigate and help you resolve the issue.

reviews.name: Dave Sykes
reviews.text:
Both our meals left a lot to be desired. Will not be using again.
Singapore fried rice was white rice with curry powder added and very little meat or veg. Sweet and sour special was barely cooked and tasteless,plus £5+ for plain noodles and the ribs were overcooked/ fried.
reviews.textTranslated:
Kedua makanan kami sangat mengecewakan. Tidak akan memesan lagi.
Nasi goreng Singapura hanyalah nasi putih dengan tambahan bubuk kari dan sedikit sekali daging atau sayuran. Spesial asam manisnya hampir tidak matang dan hambar, ditambah lagi harganya £5+ untuk mie polos dan iganya terlalu matang/digoreng.

reviews.name: David Mason
reviews.text: Poor food. Poor service. Stick to the Wok Wow in Layton, much better.
reviews.textTranslated: Makanan tidak enak. Pelayanan buruk. Lebih baik ke Wok Wow di Layton, jauh lebih baik.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi David, I’m so sorry you wasn’t pleased with our service. Please contact us via Facebook we would like to hear your thoughts. Many thanks

reviews.name: Charlotte McCormick
reviews.text: First time ordering and it will be my last. Spent £29 great British pounds. half sweet and sour half rice which my mum said was ok but a shocking portion for nearly £9. I ordered salt and pepper chips and they delivered ordinary chips so I had to phone up and ask for my salt and pepper chips. (£6.30 btw) 🤣  by the time they arrived the rest of the food was freezing. I was looking forward to the chips and they were literally just tossed in Chinese five spice no veg bar a few slithers of overcooked soggy onion and they looked miserable and my “crispy” chicken in spicy sauce was soggy before the sauce was even poured on. I was expecting wok wow Layton standard but this was just abysmal.  Greedy prices that don’t reflect the quality.
reviews.textTranslated: Ini pertama kalinya saya memesan dan akan menjadi yang terakhir. Saya menghabiskan 29 poundsterling Inggris. Setengah nasi asam manis, setengahnya lagi nasi, yang menurut ibu saya lumayan, tetapi porsinya sangat sedikit untuk harga hampir 9 poundsterling. Saya memesan kentang goreng garam dan merica, tetapi mereka mengirimkan kentang goreng biasa, jadi saya harus menelepon dan meminta kentang goreng garam dan merica saya. (6,30 poundsterling) 🤣 Saat kentang goreng itu tiba, makanan lainnya sudah dingin membeku. Saya sangat menantikan kentang gorengnya, tetapi kentang goreng itu hanya dilumuri bumbu lima rempah Cina, tanpa sayuran, hanya beberapa irisan bawang bombay yang terlalu matang dan lembek, dan penampilannya sangat buruk. Ayam "renyah" saya dengan saus pedas sudah lembek bahkan sebelum sausnya dituangkan. Saya mengharapkan standar Wok Wow Layton, tetapi ini benar-benar mengerikan. Harga yang terlalu mahal dan tidak sesuai dengan kualitasnya.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Charlotte 

I do apologize that you are not satisfied with the pricing on third party platform. We recommend to place order from our own website as we do have dearer deal for our customers, a lot cheaper. 
 Thank you for your feedback and it’s important to us for further references. Thank you for your time to leave us your thoughts. Sorry for your experience. Please  contact us via Facebook if we can assist you further . Thanks a gain

reviews.name: Katy Aston
reviews.text:
Have been regular customers since the Poulton branch opened and before that to the Layton branch.
Has become very clear there are 2 different chefs. Ordered on Saturday, food cooked well and delicious. Ordered the exact same today - Singapore vermicelli bland, tasteless no peppers , prawn toast overcooked went in the bin.
Wont be ordering on a Wednesday anymore.
To add the shop staff and delivery staff are great and delivery is always fast.
reviews.textTranslated:
Saya sudah menjadi pelanggan tetap sejak cabang Poulton dibuka dan sebelumnya di cabang Layton.
Sudah sangat jelas bahwa ada 2 koki yang berbeda. Saya memesan pada hari Sabtu, makanan dimasak dengan baik dan lezat. Saya memesan hal yang sama persis hari ini - bihun Singapura hambar, tanpa rasa, tanpa paprika, roti udang terlalu matang, langsung saya buang.
Saya tidak akan memesan lagi pada hari Rabu.
Sebagai tambahan, staf toko dan staf pengiriman sangat ramah dan pengiriman selalu cepat.

reviews.name: Kerry Stafford
reviews.text: Gorgeous food, polite staff and fast delivery.
reviews.textTranslated: Makanan yang lezat, staf yang ramah, dan pengiriman yang cepat.

reviews.name: Claire Allmond
reviews.text: I go here quite a lot because the food is so good!!! really nicely prepared but the front of house girl is quite rude & seems to always ask if I want my change !!?? Yes please ! really rude !! X
reviews.textTranslated: Saya sering makan di sini karena makanannya enak banget!!! Disiapkan dengan sangat baik, tapi pelayan di depan agak kasar & sepertinya selalu bertanya apakah saya mau kembalian!!?? Ya, tolong! Benar-benar kasar!! X

reviews.name: NW UK
reviews.text:
Just don’t!

Awful in every way.
reviews.textTranslated:
Jangan!

Sangat buruk.

reviews.name: Chris Tedder
reviews.text: Come every week and food is always spot on.
reviews.textTranslated: Datang tiap minggu dan makanannya selalu enak.

reviews.name: Mohammed amzad Hosen
reviews.text: I order a take way amazing food and amazing service. Highly recommend to any one who one Chinese.
reviews.textTranslated: Saya pesan makanan untuk dibawa pulang, makanannya luar biasa dan pelayanannya juga luar biasa. Sangat direkomendasikan untuk siapa pun yang suka masakan Tionghoa.

reviews.name: Ellie Gregory
reviews.text: Salt and pepper chips from here are my absolute favourite and the price is very reasonable and portion sizes are amazing. I would definitely recommend coming here and will definitely be going back.
reviews.textTranslated: Keripik kentang rasa garam dan lada dari sini adalah favorit saya, harganya sangat terjangkau, dan porsinya luar biasa. Saya pasti akan merekomendasikan tempat ini dan pasti akan kembali lagi.

reviews.name: Demi Purcell
reviews.text: Amazing food , good delivery time polite staff
reviews.textTranslated: Makanan luar biasa, waktu pengiriman tepat, staf ramah.

reviews.name: Leon Murray
reviews.text: The food was absolutely shocking.Salt and pepper chicken pink, crispy beef burnt on the inside what a joke when you’re trying to enjoy your weekend with a nice Chinese. Would strongly recommend to stay away from this place. Only decent thing was the girl on the phone dealing with their shitty problems what a joke. ( STAY AWAY) !!!!!!!!! BTW £35.95)
reviews.textTranslated: Makanannya benar-benar mengejutkan. Ayam garam dan merica berwarna merah muda, daging sapi renyah gosong di dalam, sungguh lelucon ketika Anda mencoba menikmati akhir pekan Anda dengan makanan Cina yang enak. Sangat disarankan untuk menjauhi tempat ini. Satu-satunya hal yang lumayan adalah gadis di telepon yang menangani masalah mereka yang menyebalkan, sungguh lelucon. (JAUHILAH TEMPAT INI) !!!!!!!!! (Harganya £35.95)

reviews.name: Sarah Sharples
reviews.text: Just had chicken curry and salt and pepper chicken and chicken slightly pink in both dishes and curry had fatty curry juice on top, ate some but left most of it so that was a waste of £32
reviews.textTranslated: Saya baru saja makan kari ayam dan ayam garam merica, ayamnya agak merah muda di kedua hidangan dan kari ayamnya berkuah kental di atasnya, saya makan sedikit tapi meninggalkan sebagian besar jadi itu buang-buang uang sebesar £32.

reviews.name: Linn Gee
reviews.text:
AVOID  850 for 5 chicken nuggets
-under cooked tough chicken  cooked in old oil
-Watery rice
-Batter taste rancid too
reviews.textTranslated:
HINDARI 850 untuk 5 nugget ayam
-ayam setengah matang yang alot dimasak dengan minyak lama
-nasi encer
-adonannya terlalu tengik
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi 

I’d feel sorry for your feedback. 

I would like to clarify that Chicken nuggets isn’t on our menu. However all our portions are standard to full container and if it’s chicken balls it would be minimum of 8 and up to 10 pieces. As you might aware, you were actually ordered Special All in 1 Box, half & half in one box but not the full portion of the menu. 

Our House Special Fried Rice is saucy fried rice which is all mixed meat cooked in oyster sauce with vegetables on top of fried rice. Unless otherwise you order the wrong dishes, example: Special Fried rice which is STIR FRIED RICE(DRY). All the different is listed on the menu if you carefully read the menu. 

We changed our cooking oil very often but it can be considered “old” if after  second day. 

I hope you’d refer your complaint to our shop manager before we can discuss your dissatisfaction. Thank you

reviews.name: Michelle McDortch
reviews.text:
I’ve been ordering from WW for over 15 years. The last couple of years the food has started to be dry. The rice, especially the wings and some of the beef meals and the chicken balls have become 70% batter.
I’ve stayed with it cause I thought it might get better.
Today when going to order the salt and chilli box which I usually get, there is now only one option. A large which contains exactly what the smaller size used to have, maybe a few more chips to bulk it out?
It was £17.50, it’s now £26.60.
I’ll be giving this a miss for a while. Times are hard enough without the greed of food businesses.
reviews.textTranslated:
Saya sudah memesan dari WW selama lebih dari 15 tahun. Beberapa tahun terakhir ini makanannya mulai kering. Nasi, terutama sayap ayam dan beberapa hidangan daging sapi serta bola ayam, isinya 70% adonan.

Saya tetap berlangganan karena saya pikir mungkin akan membaik.
Hari ini ketika saya akan memesan kotak garam dan cabai yang biasa saya pesan, sekarang hanya ada satu pilihan. Ukuran besar yang isinya persis sama dengan ukuran kecil sebelumnya, mungkin ditambah sedikit kentang goreng untuk menambah isinya?
Harganya dulu £17,50, sekarang £26,60.
Saya akan berhenti memesan dari sini untuk sementara waktu. Kehidupan sudah cukup sulit tanpa keserakahan bisnis makanan.

reviews.name: Iona Conner
reviews.text: The delivery took an hour and half to arrive when only stated it would take an hour and five. When the food has arrive it was barely warm and the chicken wings looked as though they had been cooked and left out for a long time and tasted very dry. The small box was basically all chips and the ribs also look dry and burnt. Think wisely about ordering from here .
reviews.textTranslated: Pesanan membutuhkan waktu satu setengah jam untuk sampai, padahal yang tertera hanya satu jam lima menit. Saat makanan tiba, suhunya sudah sangat dingin dan sayap ayamnya tampak seperti sudah dimasak dan dibiarkan terlalu lama, serta rasanya sangat kering. Kotak kecil itu isinya hampir semua kentang goreng dan iga juga terlihat kering dan gosong. Pikirkan baik-baik sebelum memesan dari sini.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Iona,

Please accept my apologies. Thank you for leaving your first view feedback concerning about the food quality. Just so you know im going to forward your feedback to our kitchen team for future reference. Please let me get thing right. I would like you to check your inbox whenever possible as I’ll send you more updates about your order. Hopefully I’ll hear from you soon. Thank you. 

Best regards,

Wok Wow Poulton

reviews.name: John mugbusiness
reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant quality food and service. Outstanding salt and pepper prawns and just outstanding service and quality dishes .Highly recommended.
reviews.textTranslated: Kualitas makanan dan layanannya sungguh luar biasa. Udang garam dan mericanya luar biasa, dan layanan serta hidangannya pun luar biasa. Sangat direkomendasikan.

reviews.name: Lucy Hemming
reviews.text: Hot good food
reviews.textTranslated: Makanan panas yang enak

reviews.name: Danny Worrall
reviews.text: I travel every week from Manchester  nd I eat salt and pepper chicken  but must admit it's my favourite  place to go
reviews.textTranslated: Saya bepergian setiap minggu dari Manchester dan saya makan ayam garam dan merica, tetapi harus saya akui itu adalah tempat favorit saya untuk dikunjungi.

reviews.name: clive chorley
reviews.text: Lovely delicately flavoured pork fried rice with the bonus of fresh peas in it. Pleasantly crispy chicken balls, 9 instead of our usual restaurants 10, thick tasty sauce. High quality ingredients and exceptionally fast delivery . 5x star experience many thanks.
reviews.textTranslated: Nasi goreng babi yang lezat dan beraroma lembut dengan tambahan kacang polong segar. Bola-bola ayam yang renyah, 9 buah, bukan 10 seperti di restoran biasa, saus kental yang lezat. Bahan-bahan berkualitas tinggi dan pengiriman yang sangat cepat. Pengalaman bintang 5, terima kasih banyak.

reviews.name: TJ Rossi
reviews.text: Best bbq ribs in the area 😋
reviews.textTranslated: Iga bakar terbaik di daerah ini 😋

reviews.name: Mike Croston
reviews.text: Have ordered for the passed couple of days absolutely fantastic service both on the phone having to editing the online which was my own fault forgetting a part of the order was very polite and helpful food arrived on time 10/10 would definitely recommend 😋 will be ordering from wokwow for future Chinese orders
reviews.textTranslated: Saya sudah memesan selama beberapa hari terakhir dan pelayanannya benar-benar fantastis, baik melalui telepon maupun saat mengedit pesanan online (kesalahan saya sendiri karena lupa sebagian pesanan). Pelayanannya sangat sopan dan membantu, makanan tiba tepat waktu 10/10, pasti akan saya rekomendasikan 😋. Saya akan memesan dari Wokwow untuk pesanan makanan Cina di masa mendatang.

reviewContext.Rekomendasi hidangan: Egg Fried Rice, Chicken Curry, Boiled Rice
reviewContext.Kesesuaian untuk anak-anak: Staff are very polite and helpful
